name: Hinase Midori
source:
Part of unit Eme☆Kare

He has a deep voice contrary to his pretty appearance and is sensitive to others pointing out this gap.
He looks like an orthodox princely type at first glance, but he is actually an airhead that happens to possess natural idol-like quality.
